question: Can the remaining valid full-file LL fallbacks be replaced by local decisions without corpus identity, source text, or file-order heuristics?
control: The seven generated-parser transforms accepted before issue #20.

commands.control: LAB_GENERATED_OPTIMIZATIONS=generalElement,collectionMethodCall,generalElementPart,generalElementPartPrediction,bulkCollectAlias,routineName,unaryExpressionCore pnpm grammar:generate && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm benchmark:production --manifest .work/private-production/manifest.json --selection full --repeats 3 --experiment 022-remaining-ll-fallbacks-control
commands.candidate: pnpm grammar:generate && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm benchmark:production --manifest .work/private-production/manifest.json --selection full --repeats 3 --experiment 022-remaining-ll-fallbacks

selection: Complete frozen 1,244-file opaque production corpus with the same manifest, file identities, and digests as experiments 011–021. Three fresh-process cache-reuse passes per state.
acceptance: No corpus identity, source path, source text, or file-order heuristic.
Every removed full-file fallback is explained by a local grammar decision.
No parse-tree, token, diagnostic, acceptance, or recovery difference.
A repeatable full-corpus parser-core improvement with unchanged fallback semantics for rejected files.
